title: Do Vision SAEs Capture Object-Part Decompositions or Only Holistic Concepts?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If SAEs capture parts, they are more useful for fine-grained safety analysis of visual models. The chain to safety is plausible through visual manipulation detection, but somewhat indirect — the finding mostly advances interpretability methodology.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: ViT-Prisma provides spatial visualization tools. Training a SAE on a ViT layer is feasible on medium compute. Generating heatmaps and classifying features as part-vs-whole requires manual annotation effort but is conceptually accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: part-selective vs whole-object-selective feature ratio. However, training the SAE, selecting features, generating heatmaps, and manually categorizing them is multi-step. Doable in 30 hours if limited to one object category.
